issues.detail: The Hebrew 'הַסֹּפֵר' means 'the scribe' (sofer), but the Chinese renders it as '數目示巴拿' which appears to combine 'the scribe' with the name 'Shebna' (示巴拿) in a way that misidentifies the title. The Hebrew has 'וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר' = 'and Shebna the scribe', but the Chinese '和數目示巴拿' seems to render 'הַסֹּפֵר' as '數目' (number/count) attached to the name, which is a mistranslation of the title 'scribe'.
